title: Hospital visiting hours
instructions: Bir hastane ziyaret kurallarını anlatan bir kayıt. Saatleri ve kuralları karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Thank you for calling City Hospital. Here is information about visiting hours.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Visiting hours are from two to four in the afternoon, and from six to eight in the evening.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: On the children's ward, parents can visit at any time.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Only two visitors can see a patient at the same time.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Please do not bring flowers. You can bring fruit, books or magazines.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: The hospital car park is very full. We recommend taking bus number eleven, which stops at the main entrance.

questions.prompt: When are the afternoon visiting hours?
questions.feedback: Öğleden sonra ziyaret saatleri ikiden dörde.
questions.evidence: Visiting hours are from two to four in the afternoon

questions.prompt: Who can visit at any time?
questions.feedback: Çocuk servisinde ebeveynler her zaman ziyaret edebilir.
questions.evidence: On the children's ward, parents can visit at any time.

questions.prompt: How many visitors can see a patient at the same time?
questions.evidence: Only two visitors can see a patient at the same time.

questions.feedback: Çiçek getirmeyin; meyve, kitap ve dergi olabilir.

questions.prompt: How should visitors come to the hospital?
questions.feedback: Otopark çok dolu; on bir numaralı otobüs öneriliyor.
questions.evidence: We recommend taking bus number eleven
